Approve revised preliminary plat to create 885 lots from the remaining 179.4 acres of the overall Hill Valley development still to be platted. The lots will include 856 lots for a variety of single-family housing that will range from street- and alley-loaded single-family detached residences, two-family dwelling twin homes, and single-family attached dwellings (townhouses), as well as 10 multi-family lots, one outlot for future mixed-use development, and 18 public and private outlotsRequest/Application Type:SUBDIVISION PLATLegislative Files:92387Status:Application Under Review
